spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes truthfulness and calibration. spans.text: Bias toward genuine gaps, not "more is better." A false-positive addition costs the review budget and dilutes the operator's attention.
spans.note: The prompt preserves operator agency by making all additions best-effort (not required), capping additions to prevent overwhelming the operator, and explicitly warning against diluting the operator's attention with unnecessary additions. The design keeps consequential decisions (required reviewers) under deterministic rule control, not LLM discretion.

spans.text: Fail-closed defaults: no critic additions are merged into the final plan; a MEDIUM `Coverage` finding with `system_marker:
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates strong action safety principles. It enforces a closed vocabulary for reviewer names (preventing injection of unauthorized reviewers), caps additions at 5, enforces additive-only changes (cannot remove existing reviewers), and has a fail-closed default mechanism when validation fails. These are all least-privilege and validation-first patterns.
